name: runners-io
description: GitHub Actions results and merge conflicts for your pull requests, read from GitHub with your own GitHub login and pushed into your Claude Code session as they happen (a Channels research preview). Works for any repository that uses GitHub Actions, with no runners.io account. It watches the pull request for your branch, and one just opened by you in the same repository; Claude subscribes to any other.

telemetry.title: Send runners.io an install ping and reports of the plugin's own faults
telemetry.description: on (default): once when the plugin is installed or updated, and when the plugin's own code fails, it sends runners.io a small message with no repository, path, login or token in it (the README's Telemetry section lists every field). off: it sends runners.io nothing.

auto_subscribe.title: Watch the current branch's pull request automatically
auto_subscribe.description: pr: the channel watches the pull request for the branch your session's folder is on, without being asked (default). off: only the pull requests Claude subscribes to; the hook then watches nothing on its own either.

review_requests.title: Tell me when somebody asks me for a review
review_requests.description: on: every few minutes the channel asks GitHub which open pull requests ask your GitHub login (or one of its teams) for a review, and tells the session about each new request. off: it does not ask (default). Every session with this on hears every request.
